About Emailable 
 Emailable is a leading email verification and deliverability platform trusted by 200,000+ businesses globally, from scrappy startups to household names. We power mission-critical email infrastructure that must be fast, accurate, compliant, and always on.
 We’re a highly efficient, globally distributed team. We move fast, build obsessively, and take deep pride in operational excellence.
 Now we’re hiring a VP of Operations to help scale the company from strong product-market fit to the next level of uptime, reliability, and operational precision.
 Role Overview 
 The VP of Operations is the execution engine of Emailable.
 You will own the day-to-day operational machine across support, engineering coordination, quality, compliance, and internal systems. Your job is to make the business run smoothly, predictably, and without the founder being pulled into every fire.
 This is a hands-on operator role , not a corporate strategy job. You will build processes, fix broken ones, create operational clarity, and raise the standard of execution across the company.
 If you’ve scaled a SaaS company from $1M–$15M ARR and love building repeatable, efficient, high-tempo operating systems: you’ll thrive here.
 What You’ll Own 
 1. Operational Execution 
 Build and maintain the operating cadence of the entire company 
 Run weekly standups, sprint reviews, and cross-functional syncs 
 Ensure priorities are executed on time, every time 
 Develop dashboards for SLAs, product delivery, and reliability 
 2. Support & Customer Operations 
 Maintain best-in-class support SLAs 
 Oversee ticket management, escalation paths, QA of responses 
 Identify patterns in support and feed them into product/engineering 
 3. Engineering & Product Coordination 
 Facilitate sprint planning and execution 
 Ensure engineering deadlines are realistic and met 
 Unblock bottlenecks across engineering, QA, and product 
 Build the communication layer between product, engineering, and support 
 4. Compliance & Reliability 
 Manage SOC2 initiatives, audits, and ongoing compliance 
 Oversee GDPR processes (DSARs, deletion workflows, DPIAs) 
 Tighten privacy ops, logging, and risk mitigation 
 5. Cross-Functional Alignment 
 Create company-wide visibility into priorities 
 Ensure everyone is working on what matters most 
 Build operational clarity, documentation, and SOPs 
 6. Team & Vendor Oversight 
 Manage contractors, LATAM talent, and global contributors 
 Implement performance standards and accountability systems 
 Optimize tooling and operational workflows (Crisp, Basecamp, HubSpot, etc.) 
 What You’ll Build in Your First 90 Days 
 A predictable weekly operating rhythm 
 A unified KPI dashboard for operations 
 A clean support workflow with A repeatable engineering release cadence 
 An org-wide roadmap with true visibility 
 A compliance process that doesn’t rely on the founder 
 SOPs for the highest-friction areas of the business 
 You will take ownership of the machine so the CEO can focus on growth, partnerships, brand, and strategy.
 What Success Looks Like in 12 Months 
 90% of operational fires never reach the CEO 
 Release cadence increases 50–100% 
 Support meets or exceeds SLAs consistently 
 Internal communication becomes predictable and structured 
 Churn decreases due to operational improvements 
 Compliance becomes a non-issue 
 Engineering executes without drama or drift 
 Company runs smoother than it ever has
 Must-Haves 
 3–7+ years in SaaS operations (B2B strongly preferred) 
 Experience in a $1M–$15M+ ARR environment 
 Very strong project management + execution discipline 
 Understands engineering cycles, product communication, and support workflows 
 Obsessed with systems, clarity, and efficiency 
 Excels in fast-paced, minimal-politics, high-ownership environments 
 Nice-to-Haves 
 Experience with API-first or infrastructure SaaS 
 GDPR/SOC2 familiarity 
 Background in support operations 
 Experience with global teams (LATAM, EU, Asia) 
 Ability to grow into a COO role 
 Why You’ll Love Working Here 
 Zero bureaucracy, you’ll move incredibly fast 
 High-trust, high-ownership environment 
 You’ll work directly with the CEO and shape how the entire company operates 
 A product with real traction and real demand 
 Global distributed team, minimal meetings, deep-work culture 
 Clear path to future COO or CEO
 Fully Remote Work 
 Work from anywhere. We’re a globally distributed team that optimizes for deep work, autonomy, and output — not office hours.
 Competitive Compensation 
 Strong base salary + performance bonus + meaningful equity. We pay for talent and expect high ownership in return.
 Flexible Time Off 
 We operate like adults — take time when you need it. No complicated policies, no counting days.
 Family-Friendly Policies 
 We support parents with:

 Real understanding of life outside work

 We encourage sustainable work (not burnout) and provide access to wellness stipends or services to keep you performing at your best.

À propos de Mila 
 Fondé par le professeur Yoshua Bengio de l’Université de Montréal, Mila rassemble des chercheurs spécialisés en intelligence artificielle et plus précisément en apprentissage automatique, apprentissage profond et apprentissage par renforcement. Reconnu mondialement pour ses importantes contributions au domaine de l’apprentissage profond, Mila s’est particulièrement distingué dans la modélisation du langage, la traduction automatique, la reconnaissance d’objets et les modèles génératifs. Depuis 2017, Mila est le fruit d’une collaboration entre l’Université de Montréal et l’Université McGill, en lien étroit avec Polytechnique Montréal et HEC Montréal.

 About Mila 
 Founded by Professor Yoshua Bengio of the Université de Montréal, Mila brings together researchers specializing in artificial intelligence, and more specifically in machine learning, deep learning and reinforcement learning. Recognized worldwide for its important contributions to the field of deep learning, Mila has particularly distinguished itself in language modeling, machine translation, object recognition and generative models. Since 2017, Mila has been the fruit of a collaboration between Université de Montréal and McGill University, with close links to Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal.
 Mila's mission is to be a global hub of scientific advances that inspires innovation and the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) for the benefit of all.
 To find out more, please visit https://mila.quebec/ 
 Sommaire du poste: Spécialiste principal de la plateforme, Laboratoire d'IA Souveraine 
 Le Laboratoire d'IA Souveraine est une nouvelle initiative de Mila visant à assembler une pile (stack) d'inférence IA open source et prête pour les entreprises, que les organisations peuvent déployer et exploiter sur des infrastructures qu'elles contrôlent. Elle regroupe des fonctionnalités telles que le service de modèles, la recherche d'information, l'orchestration d'agents, l'observabilité et un plan de contrôle pour gérer ces composants comme un produit cohérent.
 Relevant du directeur principal du dévellopement logiciel , vous concevrez et maintiendrez à jour des paquets de déploiement et d'automatisation pour la pile. Ces paquets et automatisations permettent aux partenaires de déployer, mettre à niveau et restaurer la pile sur leur propre infrastructure, d'un simple nœud jusqu'à des grappes Kubernetes de production. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe d'intégration pour paqueter leurs composants et les déployer dans des environnements de référence via des flux de travail partagés. Vous recommanderez des technologies de plateforme basées sur des tests reproductibles, des exigences opérationnelles et l'adéquation à l'architecture. Ce rôle ne comporte pas de garde sur appel.
 Le succès signifie que les partenaires peuvent déployer, mettre à niveau, restaurer et exploiter la pile de manière autonome dans les environnements pris en charge, en utilisant des automatisations et des guides d'utilisation vérifiés.
 Principales responsabilités
 Concevoir et maintenir l'infrastructure-code pour les environnements pris en charge. Documenter les exigences matérielles et d'infrastructure.
 Évaluer les technologies de plateforme open-source par le biais de tests et de bancs d'essai reproductibles. Consigner les méthodes, les résultats, les limites et les risques de maintenance. Recommander des options.
 Créer et maintenir des packages de déploiement versionnés et des flux de travail partagés avec l'équipe d'intégration. Automatiser l'installation, la configuration, les mises à niveau, les retours en arrière, les sauvegardes et les restauations.
 Construire et gérer l'infrastructure d'intégration continue (CI) et des environnements de référence reproductibles. Automatiser les tests de publication sur l'ensemble des environnements pris en charge et enregistrer les résultats.
 Mettre en place et tester les contrôles de sécurité et les paramètres sécurisés par défaut de la plateforme. Tester les mises à jour de sécurité avant de les intégrer aux versions. Fournir des guides de procédures testés pour permettre aux partenaires de connecter leurs systèmes d'identité et d'accès.
 Connecter la télémétrie de l'infrastructure aux services d'observabilité de la pile. Paqueter les tableaux de bord et les alertes de la plateforme.
 Tester la fiabilité, les performances, la capacité et l'utilisation des ressources de la plateforme par rapport aux objectifs convenus. Utiliser les résultats pour améliorer la configuration des déploiements, les packages et l'automatisation.
 Reproduire les échecs de déploiement signalés par les partenaires dans les environnements de référence. Publier des correctifs pour les packages de déploiement et l'automatisation.
 Maintenir et vérifier les guides d'exploitation, les guides de dimensionnement et les instructions de dépannage afin que les partenaires puissent déployer et exploiter la pile de manière indépendante.
 Diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de la plateforme. Établir des normes d'ingénierie, réviser le travail technique et mentorer les ingénieures et ingénieurs.
 Position Summary: Staff Platform Specialist, Sovereign AI Lab 
 The Sovereign AI Lab is a new Mila initiative to assemble an enterprise-ready, open-source AI inference stack that organizations can deploy and operate on infrastructure they control. It brings together functionalities such as model serving, retrieval, agent orchestration, observability, and a control plane to operate these components as one coherent product.
 Reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering, you will build and maintain deployment packages and automation for the stack. The packages and automation let partners deploy, upgrade, and roll back the stack on their own infrastructure, from a single node to production Kubernetes clusters. You will work with the integration team to package their components and deploy them to reference environments through shared workflows. You will recommend platform technologies based on reproducible tests, operational requirements, and architecture fit. This role does not include on-call duty.
 Success means partners can deploy, upgrade, roll back, and operate the stack independently in supported environments, using verified automation and runbooks.
 Main Responsibilities
 Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code for supported environments. Document hardware and infrastructure requirements.
 Evaluate open-source platform technologies through reproducible tests and benchmarks. Record methods, results, limitations, and maintenance risks. Recommend options.
 Build and maintain versioned deployment packages and shared workflows with the integration team. Automate installation, configuration, upgrades, rollback, backup, and restore.
 Build and run CI infrastructure and reproducible reference environments. Automate release tests across supported environments and record results.
 Build and test platform security controls and secure defaults. Test security updates before including them in releases. Provide tested playbooks for partners to connect their identity and access systems.
 Connect infrastructure telemetry to the stack's observability services. Package platform dashboards and alerts.
 Test platform reliability, performance, capacity, and resource use against agreed targets. Use results to improve deployment configuration, packages, and automation.
 Reproduce partner-reported deployment failures in reference environments. Release fixes to deployment packages and automation.
 Maintain and verify runbooks, sizing guides, and troubleshooting instructions so partners can deploy and operate the stack independently.
 Lead platform design and implementation. Set engineering standards, review technical work, and mentor engineers.
 Qualifications requises
 Plus de 7 ans d'expérience dans la création et l'exploitation d'infrastructures de production.
 Expérience dans la direction de la conception, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de plateformes de production, y compris les revues techniques, les normes d'ingénierie et le mentorat.
 Solide expérience du déploiement, de l'exploitation et du dépannage de Linux, des conteneurs, de Kubernetes et de Docker, y compris la gestion des réseaux et du stockage persistant.
 Expérience de la gestion d'infrastructure sous forme de code et de l'utilisation d'outils comme Helm pour paqueter et déployer des systèmes multiservices dans divers environnements et matériels, avec gestion des accès et des secrets.
 Expérience dans la création et l'exploitation d'infrastructures d'intégration continue (CI) et de flux de travail de publication vérifiant le déploiement, les mises à niveau, les retours en arrière, les sauvegardes et les restaurations.
 Expérience de la gestion de la télémétrie d'infrastructure basée sur OpenTelemetry, de l'intégration à l'analyse avec la suite Grafana LGTM ou un équivalent.
 Expérience avec Ansible et des outils d'infrastructure-code open source, combinée à de fortes compétences en script shell et en programmation Python (ou langage similaire) pour automatiser des plateformes et concevoir des services et des outils.
 Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit; capacité à expliquer des compromis techniques et à rédiger des guides d'exploitation et de dépannage clairs pour permettre un déploiement et une exploitation autonomes de la pile par les partenaires.
 Expérience utile
 Exploitation de GPU ou d'autres accélérateurs et de charges de travail d'inférence d'IA en production.
 Déploiement de logiciels sur des infrastructures exploitées par des clients ou des partenaires.
 Déploiement dans des environnements isolés (« air-gapped »), réglementés ou souverains.
 Maintenance ou contribution à des projets d'infrastructure open source.
 Intégration de déploiements avec des services d'identité externes.
 Required Qualifications
 7+ years of experience building and operating production infrastructure.
 Experience leading the design, delivery, and operation of production platforms, including technical reviews, engineering standards, and mentoring.
 Deep experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting Linux, containers, Kubernetes, and Docker, including networking and persistent storage.
 Experience managing infrastructure as code and using tools like Helm to package and deploy multi-service systems across environments and hardware, with access controls and secrets management.
 Experience building and operating CI infrastructure and release workflows that test deployment, upgrades, rollback, backup, and restore.
 Experience managing OpenTelemetry-based infrastructure telemetry from integration to analysis with the Grafana LGTM stack or equivalent.
 Experience with Ansible and open-source infrastructure-as-code tools, plus strong shell scripting and programming skills in Python or a similar language to automate platforms and build services and tools.
 Strong written and spoken English and French; explain technical tradeoffs and write clear runbooks and troubleshooting guides enabling partners’ independent stack deployment and operation.
 Useful Experience
 Operating GPUs or other accelerators and AI inference workloads in production.
 Deploying software on infrastructure that customers or partners operate.
 Deploying to air-gapped, regulated, or sovereign environments.
 Maintaining or contributing to open-source infrastructure projects.
 Integrating deployments with external identity services.

 VP, Business Group Information Security Officer, Sun Life Canada 
 Job Purpose  
 The Vice-President, Business Group Information Security Officer, Canada (BG CISO) serves as a senior security leader and partner to the Business Group leadership team and Business Group President.  Acting as the senior security executive for the Business Group and the primary bridge between the business and enterprise Security function, the BG CISO provides independent oversight and challenge of cyber risk, resilience and security outcomes across the business group. 
 The BG CISO, Sun Life Canada is accountable for cyber risk, resilience, and security outcomes for Sun Life Canada, one of the company’s core markets and a leader in health, wealth and protection, serving Clients across Canada through group benefits, individual insurance, wealth, advice and distribution channels.  
The Canadian business is made up of complex ecosystems, requiring strong alignment with Canadian regulatory expectations, enterprise risk practices and digital/client-service priorities.  Reporting directly to the global Chief Security Officer this position will have direct and indirect reports including a team of ~ 10 security leads and advisors aligned to the Canada business and subsidiary priorities including oversight of Dialogue security, product/platform risk, incident readiness, and stakeholder engagement. 
 The BG CISO partners closely with executives, technology leaders, risk partners, and the enterprise security team to protect critical assets, enable innovation, strengthen resilience, and ensure risks are understood and managed within the organization's risk appetite. The BG CISO is accountable for providing independent business-aligned security oversight while enabling growth, innovation and transformation across the Business Group. The role translates complex cyber and security risks into business impacts and shapes strategy, investments, priorities, and operating decisions across the Business Group.  
 Scope, Decision Authority and Key Interfaces  
 The Vice-President, Business Group Information Security Officer serves as the senior security executive and trusted advisor to the Business Group President and leadership team. The role is accountable for cyber risk oversight, executive advisory services, security governance, resilience alignment, regulatory engagement, and independent challenge across the assigned business group. The Vice-President translates enterprise security strategy into business-relevant actions while ensuring cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and security priorities are appropriately considered within business decisions and transformation initiatives.  
 The Vice-President has delegated authority to establish business-group security governance routines, direct security assessments, challenge risk decisions, require remediation planning, recommend security investment priorities, and escalate material cyber and resilience concerns through appropriate governance channels. Within approved authorities, the role provides independent advice and challenge regarding cyber risk, resilience, technology transformation, regulatory obligations, third-party risk, and risk acceptance decisions. Where management disagreement exists regarding material cyber risk acceptance, the matter will be escalated to the Global Chief Information Security Officer for review and discussion with the applicable Business Group President before a final decision is made. 
 The role is accountable for business-group security oversight, executive advisory services, risk escalation, independent challenge, alignment of enterprise security services to business priorities, and operational ownership of Business Group Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platforms and associated security outcomes. The role does not own enterprise cyber defence operations, enterprise security platform engineering, vulnerability remediation, incident response operations, or second-line risk oversight except where responsibilities are expressly assigned. The Vice-President works closely with Enterprise Security leaders to ensure Business Group CIAM capabilities remain aligned with enterprise architecture, security standards, resilience requirements, and regulatory obligations. 
 Matters escalated to the Chief Information Security Officer would typically include significant cyber or operational resilience concerns, material breaches of risk appetite, major regulatory matters, unresolved management actions, significant third-party security issues, material client commitments, or disagreements regarding risk acceptance, prioritization, or investment decisions. 
 Major Accountabilities   
 Strategic Security Leadership and Vision  
 Serve as the primary Security advisor to the Business Group executive team and Business Group President. 
 Accountable for defining and driving the Business Group security strategy, aligned to enterprise security priorities and business objectives. 
 Ensure security considerations are integrated into business strategy, transformation initiatives, digital strategies, and operational decision-making. 
 Report significant changes in risk to appropriate levels of leadership on a periodic and event-driven basis.  
 Exercise independent challenge and escalate material cyber, technology, resilience and security risks through appropriate governance forums when risk exposure exceeds established risk appetite or remediation commitments are not achieved.  
 Deliver timely insights and data to enable informed executive decision-making, prioritization, and risk-based trade-offs.  
 Influence and shape multi-year security, resilience, and technology risk investment strategies, ensuring resource allocation aligns with business priorities, regulatory expectations and evolving threat landscapes.  
 Identify emerging threats, trends, and regulatory developments that may impact the Business Group and proactively develop mitigation strategies. 
 Business Partnership & Influence  
 Build trusted relationships with business and technology executives. 
 Act as the voice of the Business Group within the CISO organization and as the voice of the CISO organization within the Business Group. 
 Facilitate effective collaboration between business stakeholders and enterprise security teams. 
 Influence business group investment priorities and strategic trade-offs related to cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and secure technology adoption 
 Cyber Risk Management  
 Accountable for the Business Group’s cyber risk posture, control effectiveness and security outcomes, ensuring material risks are identified, assessed, escalated, remediated, or formally accepted through appropriate governance and in alignment with enterprise risk appetite. 
 Facilitate cyber risk assessments across application/platform/system levels to identify vulnerabilities and potential threats, analyze impacts, and recommend protection required based on threat modeling. 
 Support business leaders in making informed risk decisions consistent with enterprise policies and risk appetite. 
 Work with the Global Cyber threat intelligence team and monitor evolving threat landscapes and advise leaders on risk implications and required actions. 
 Provide oversight of BG specific third-party cyber risk related to critical vendors, strategic partners, outsourced services, and technology providers, ensuring security risks are appropriately identified, assessed, governed, monitored and escalated as appropriate.  
 Provide independent security advice on material risk acceptance decisions and ensure risks exceeding approved appetite or delegated authority are escalated to the appropriate enterprise and business governance forums.  
 Governance, Regulatory & Compliance  
 Lead security governance activities within the Business Group. 
 Oversee regular reporting and ensure alignment to global functional teams 
 Represent Security on business governance forums, executive committees, and risk councils. 
 Ensure effective management of applicable cybersecurity, technology risk, operational resilience, regulatory, legal, and policy requirements within the Business Group. 
 Represent the Business Group during regulatory examinations, supervisory reviews, external assessments and cybersecurity-related audits.  
 Hold leaders accountable to effective remediation of audit findings, regulatory issues, and control deficiencies. 
 Security Integration & Transformation  
 Partner with the enterprise security team to ensure security services and controls meet the needs of the Business Group. 
 Provide security leadership for major initiatives, acquisitions, client commitments, strategic partnerships, and technology transformations, including cyber due diligence, risk assessment, integration planning, and oversight of material remediation commitments. 
 Enable secure adoption of emerging technologies, including cloud, AI, automation, and digital solutions, ensuring appropriate cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and governance controls are embedded throughout the lifecycle. 
 Provide oversight of information protection, data security, AI security and emerging technology risks ensuring critical information assets are protected and used responsibly and in compliance with regulatory and enterprise requirements.  
 Champion a secure-by-design approach across technology and business initiatives. 
 Incident Preparedness & Resilience  
 Serve as the senior security executive for the Business Group during significant cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and crisis events, coordinating with enterprise incident response, business continuity, legal, privacy, risk, communications, and business leadership to support timely decisions, escalation, recovery and reporting. 
 Oversee the Business Group’s cyber and operational resilience preparedness, including alignment with business continuity and crisis management, scenario testing, crisis simulations, recovery planning and oversight of resulting remediation actions.  
 Oversee the Business Group’s cyber risk assessment program across critical applications, platforms, systems, business processes, and transformation initiatives, ensuring material vulnerabilities, and threats are evaluated, prioritized, and addressed based on business impact and threat-informed analysis. 
 Security Culture & Awareness  
 Foster a strong security culture across the Business Group. 
 Promote accountability for risk management among leaders and employees. 
 Drive awareness and adoption of security best practices. 
 Leadership & Talent Development  
 Lead a network of business-aligned security leaders and professionals from across the Business Group and affiliate entities, providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of security priorities within a complex global matrix environment.  
 Present cyber risk, resilience, security posture, and emerging threats to executive committees, governance forums, and board-level audiences as required.  
 Lead through influence across complex matrixed environments. 
 Represent both the enterprise security function and business group with senior executives, regulators, auditors, and within industry forums.  
 Demonstrate executive presence and credibility with senior leaders. 
 Balance risk management with commercial and strategic objectives. 
 Drive informed decision-making under ambiguity and changing conditions. 
 Act as a trusted advisor capable of challenging constructively when risks warrant escalation. 
 Qualifications  
 Education  
 University degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Technology, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline. 
 Relevant security certifications preferred (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or equivalent). 
 Experience  
 15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, risk management, or related disciplines. 
 Experience advising senior global executives on technology and cyber risk matters. 
 Experience operating in highly regulated environments. 
 Proven ability to influence strategic and investment decisions at an executive level. 
 Experience leading large-scale transformation, risk, or security initiatives. 
 Key Knowledge & Skills  
 Deep understanding of information security, cyber risk, regulatory requirements, and resilience frameworks. 
 Strong business acumen and ability to translate technical risks into business impacts. 
 Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
 Strong understanding of enterprise technology, cloud, data, AI, and digital platforms. 
 Strategic leader with the ability to anticipate and address emerging risks and opportunities. 
 Strong judgment, influence, and decision-making capability. 
 Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed global organization. 
 Success Profile  
 The ideal candidate combines the credibility of a security leader with the mindset of a business executive. They are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, capable of enabling growth and innovation while ensuring risks are effectively understood, governed, and managed. 
 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 Okta is The World's Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology - anywhere, on any device or app. Our Identity as a Service solution enables secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.
 At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we're looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.
 The Engineering Opportunity
 Okta's Workforce Identity Cloud secures billions of global logins every day. The Platform Scalability team within the Resilience organization owns the speed, efficiency, and scale of Okta's core authentication and authorization service. We analyze and optimize system behavior across every layer of the stack - from virtualized hardware and the JVM, through MySQL query execution, caching, and the edge, up to cloud components (AWS/GCP) and application code - and we build the frameworks that keep the platform fast and protected for thousands of organizations and millions of daily active users.
 We are seeking a Senior Back-End Software Engineer to help own the scalability, efficiency, and service protection of our expanding Identity as a Service platform.
 You will build traffic-shaping and service-protection frameworks (rate limiting, concurrency limits, query timeouts, read isolation), create tooling and automation that makes latency and resource bottlenecks easy to find, and dig into production metrics to understand how the system behaves under real customer traffic. While SRE and Database Reliability Engineering keep the service up and running, the Platform Scalability team keeps it fast and efficient - and we partner closely with them to get there.
 Because we own monitoring of system latency, throughput, and resource utilization, this is not a heads-down coding role: keeping an eye on system health is part of the regular rhythm of the job, alongside project work and deep-dive investigations.
 We value iterative development, automated testing, and individual ownership. Join our creative, fast-paced team to work on impactful projects at serious scale.
 Job Duties and Responsibilities
 Design and implement backend frameworks that protect and optimize critical system resources, including rate limiting, traffic shaping, concurrency controls, and query timeout enforcement.
 Monitor production latency, throughput, and resource utilization across the database, application, cache, and edge layers; create and maintain meaningful metrics, dashboards, and alerts, often through automated tooling.
 Analyze latency and scalability bottlenecks end-to-end - JVM profiling, thread and heap analysis, SQL query plans, slow logs, and Hibernate behavior - and drive fixes in code, SQL, and configuration.
 Perform capacity and cost-efficiency analysis (for example, determining whether databases and compute are right-sized for current load), participate in weekly metrics reviews, and support onboarding of large customers and high-traffic events.
 Advise engineering teams on scalable, efficient feature design; review pull requests and SQL changes for latency, resource, and scale impact and recommend tuning or refactoring.
 Actively explore and integrate modern AI-driven developer tooling, automated diagnostics, and intelligent monitoring to accelerate latency and capacity investigations, automate analysis of metrics and logs, and reduce toil.
 Write high-quality unit and functional tests and participate in design and code reviews to keep the engineering bar high.
 Participate in on-call rotations handling latency and scale-related customer escalations, rate limit requests, and production incidents; contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and long-term mitigations.
 Collaborate closely with SRE, Database Reliability Engineering, Architects, QA, Product Owners, and Customer Support to deliver secure and dependable software.
 Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
 5+ years of experience as a software developer with strong knowledge of Java or a similar language, including a solid understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, and concurrency.
 Strong experience with relational databases - preferably MySQL and Hibernate - including query optimization, indexing, execution plan analysis, and schema design.
 Proven experience diagnosing and resolving latency, throughput, and scaling bottlenecks in high-availability, multi-tenant SaaS environments.
 Hands-on experience with profiling and observability tools (e.g., Java Flight Recorder, async-profiler, thread/heap dump analysis, Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana or similar).
 Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred, or GCP/Azure) and modern container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes).

 Martech & Data Integration: Collaborate closely with Marketing Operations and Digital Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation (Marketo).  Audience & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct advanced keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and first/third-party audience segmentation to identify high-intent targeting opportunities.
 Process Automation: Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency and scale our search program.
 Account Hygiene & Automation: Actively audit account architecture to eliminate query bleeding and campaign cannibalization. Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to scale our search program cleanly.
 Qualifications

 Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise-level, full-funnel paid search campaigns, media planning, and advanced measurement.

 VBB Expertise: Strong experience implementing and optimizing Value-Based Bidding (VBB) and offline conversion feedback loops (connecting CRM data back to ad platforms).
 AI Literacy: Practical experience leveraging AI-driven search features, automated bidding algorithms, and predictive analytics tools to scale and optimize campaigns.
 Martech Proficiency: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Salesforce (CRM), Marketo/Eloqua (Marketing Automation), and advanced web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GTM, or equivalent).
 Project Management & Communication: Strong project management skills with the ability to translate complex, multi-layered data points into clear, concise, and actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
 B2B Context: Prior experience in B2B SaaS marketing is highly preferred.
